purpose: Keep candidate ESM code out of the trusted node:test process while testing strings and byte arrays through a bounded child adapter.

operations.inspect: Child adapter reads bounded package metadata and imports the default export.
operations.string: Child adapter calls the candidate with one string and returns the string result.
operations.bytes: Child adapter calls the candidate with Uint8Array.from(bytes) and returns bytes, type, and view properties.
operations.invalid: Child adapter supplies one allowlisted invalid value and returns the candidate error contract.
